document: Synth platform case study: selected execution evidence
format_note: Public, manually selected and redacted projection of retained historical records. This is not a native Synth API schema, raw log export, independent certification, or fresh service test.

selected_campaign_scale.scope: Four selected retained July 2026 direct Runtime campaigns; not a lifetime total or Gateway-managed customer volume
selected_campaign_scale.verification: Session identities recomputed and deduplicated across the selected training and evaluation event streams; finalization/read events were not counted again.
limits: Repeated attempts are not unique tasks or successful solves.
This aggregate is not a claim that every campaign passed its learning or operational checks.
Executed optimizer updates, resumed policy-lineage progress and saved checkpoints are separate quantities.

examples.name: Direct Runtime training campaign
examples.execution_path: Direct Runtime/operator controller; not Gateway-managed customer submission
examples.model_adaptation: Rank-1 LoRA adaptation of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B through Tinker

recovery.note: The resumed provider session used a new sampler URI. Retained events link the prior sampler, configured checkpoint and resumed sampler. The checker remained false; no fresh provider-weight attestation was performed for this article.

examples.verification: Counts recomputed from saved rollout and train-step events; saved state/event hashes matched the retained checkpoint binding.
limits: Not 3000 independent tasks or 80012 independent trials.
Not an uninterrupted all-green run or a demonstrated learning-quality gain.
Configured concurrency is not a measured sustained-capacity guarantee.

examples.name: Bounded managed training and checkpoint consumption
examples.execution_path: Development Gateway-managed run submitted with an installed source-built Synth CLI
examples.verification: Retained publication receipt checked against canonical training result and separate checkpoint-consumption receipt.
limits: Synthetic verifier rewards isolate mechanism correctness; they do not demonstrate task-performance improvement.
Development only; not Production or general availability.
The specifically cited temporary local token-payload export is no longer present. Its compact receipt survives.

examples.name: Managed evaluation outcome accounting
examples.verification: Counts and distinct identities recomputed from retained per-trial extracts and checked against the saved audit.
limits: Execution completion does not mean task success or presence of a valid score.
Fixed task selection and answer-key retrieval contamination prevent using this as a benchmark-quality claim.
The original temporary aggregate export is absent; retained extracts and audit survive.

privacy: No credentials, signed URLs, internal run or tenant IDs, private trajectories, operational endpoints or company source code are included.
